paper_title: First Results from ABRACADABRA-10 cm: A Search for Sub-$μ$eV Axion Dark Matter
notes: First results from ABRACADABRA-10 cm prototype detector searching for sub-µeV axion dark matter. The paper reports 95% C.L. upper limits on axion-photon coupling g_agamma over the mass range 3.1×10^-10 eV to 8.3×10^-9 eV (frequency range 75 kHz to 2 MHz). The strongest limit is 1.4×10^-10 GeV^-1 and the weakest is 3.3×10^-9 GeV^-1. Data extracted from abstract and results section. Local DM density assumed is 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (stated in text). The experiment uses a toroidal superconducting magnet with SQUID readout to detect axion-induced magnetic fields.
